ambiguities.source_text: Compute `Avg travel from default position` as the mean of `Travel_from_default_i` over all valid trips, including the first trip.
ambiguities.intent: Average the default-position repositioning distance over every valid trip, including the first; do not collapse timestamps.

ambiguities.source_text: Treat every input row as a separate trip. Order trips by time of day; when multiple trips have the same hour and minute, preserve their original order in the input file.
ambiguities.intent: Order valid trips by Hour and Minute ascending, preserving original input order within equal timestamps; assign a separate TripID to every row.

ambiguities.source_text: If there is a tie for most frequent, select the floor label with the smallest numeric value after conversion (i.e., compare the numeric values: B=-1, G=0, and numeric floors by their integer value).
ambiguities.intent: Choose the most frequent start floor across all valid trips. If counts tie, choose the smallest numeric floor, with B=-1 and G=0.

ambiguities.source_text: Compute `Difference = (Avg travel from default position) - (Avg Travel between trips currently)` using these reported averages, and report the difference to 2 decimal places.
ambiguities.intent: Subtract the rounded current-sequence average from the rounded default-position average, then report the difference to two decimal places.

ambiguities.source_text: Report both averages and their difference to two decimal places.
ambiguities.intent: Report the averages and their difference to two decimal places. No additional midpoint rounding convention is specified.

ambiguities.source_text: The first trip in the ordered sequence has no prior trip; exclude it from the between-trips average.
ambiguities.intent: Compare each trip start with the previous trip end. Exclude only the first trip from this average because it has no preceding trip.

ambiguities.source_text: Retain every valid trip, including trips sharing the same minute and rows with identical values; do not collapse or deduplicate them.
ambiguities.intent: Each valid row is an independent trip. Keep all trips in the chronological sequence, even when timestamps or all recorded fields are identical.
